lyrics:
[Intro: swinging tom stomp, two-note distorted riff]

[Verse 1: whispered male voice]
There's a mark beside your name
Or there isn't. That's the game.
We don't read the things you write
We just check the badge is right

[Chorus: full band, snarled, gang shouts]
The verified, the verified
Step this way, the rest outside
Little tick, a little blue
Who let you in? It wasn't you
The verified

[Verse 2: whispered, synth drone under]
Bought it, earned it, born with it
Nobody asks, we just admit
Everybody in this room
Is terrified of being you

[Chorus: full band, snarled, gang shouts]
The verified, the verified
Step this way, the rest outside
Little tick, a little blue
Who let you in? It wasn't you
The verified

[Bridge: stomp only, chanted]
Check, check, check the name
Check, check, check the name

[Final Chorus: loudest, last line whispered]
The verified, the verified
Step this way, the rest outside
Little tick, a little blue
Who let you in? It wasn't you
The terrified

[Outro: stomp stops, one breath]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 145 BPM in a heavy swung shuffle, 4/4, E-flat minor. A lurching, stomping march.

VOICE: Male. Verses are whispered close to the microphone with a sneer. Choruses are a raw, distorted snarl with a gang of voices shouting the title. The last word is whispered.

INSTRUMENTS: Floor toms and kick playing a swinging stomp pattern, a down-tuned distorted guitar on a two-note riff, a fuzzed bass, a buzzing synth drone, industrial metal hits, a gated snare.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, stomp and riff. 0:14 Verse 1, whispered. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:06 Verse 2. 1:32 Chorus 2. 1:58 Bridge, chant. 2:20 Final chorus. 2:50 Outro, stop and a breath at 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-1990s industrial rock: dry, abrasive and loud, drums huge, whisper and scream both right at the front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The last word changing to 'terrified' at 2:46.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original mocks the beautiful and strong. The current pecking order is a badge beside a name, and the people who hold it are the most afraid of losing it.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Sneering, superior, exposed, afraid.
